blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Draw a line here.
exercises.why: **начертить → Начертите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Do you have enough guts?
exercises.why: **хватить → хватит** — perfective verb,  person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Speak to Lizzy about it yourself.
exercises.why: **поговорить → Поговорите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to overstep my bounds.
exercises.why: **извинить → Извините** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Can you send me her phone number?
exercises.why: **скинуть → Скинете** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Tom will graduate in October.
exercises.why: **стать → станет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll leave that up to you.
exercises.why: **предоставить → предоставлю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если он ___ (погибнуть), нам не сносить головы.
exercises.prompt: If he dies, we will face serious difficulties.
exercises.why: **погибнуть → погибнет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (процитировать) несколько строк из их письма.
exercises.prompt: I'll quote a few lines from their letter.
exercises.why: **процитировать → процитирую** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Your homeland will not forget you.
exercises.why: **забыть → забудет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: He says he will come.
exercises.why: **прийти → придет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Не подходи близко к бульдогу, вдруг ___ (укусить).
exercises.prompt: Don't come near the bulldog in case it bites.
exercises.why: **укусить → укусит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I admit that I'm tired.
exercises.why: **признаться → Признаюсь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Shall we go for a swim?
exercises.why: **пойти → пойдём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Не едь так быстро. Мы все ___ (умереть)!
exercises.prompt: Don't drive so fast. We're all going to die!
exercises.why: **умереть → умрём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's visit a mosque.
exercises.why: **посетить → посетим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Том хотел жениться после того, как ___ (закончить) вуз.
exercises.prompt: Tom wanted to get married after he graduated.
exercises.why: **закончить → закончит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: All of them will get a prize.
exercises.why: **получить → получат** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's make a list.
exercises.why: **составить → составим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Она ___ (исследовать) творчество братьев Гримм, потому что учится на литературоведа.
exercises.prompt: She is researching the Brothers Grimm, as she is a literature student.
exercises.why: **исследовать → исследует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
